title: yadakchi.seller_billing.changed.v1
description:
Whether a seller's panel offers should still be displayed.

Emitted when a wallet runs dry and again when it is topped up. It carries the DISPLAY CONSEQUENCE only — never a balance, a spend figure or a transaction. Financial truth stays inside billing and no other service computes money from it; catalog needs one boolean to decide whether to rebuild affected products.

Crawled non-panel offers are never suspended and are never affected by this event. They are free, they keep catalogue coverage alive, and removing them would punish a seller for not paying while destroying the very coverage the free listing exists to protect.

Producers: billing. Consumers: catalog.
Kafka message key: seller_key — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: compact, retention infinite.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on the listings.observed topic and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: A tombstone — payload: null with the envelope intact — means this entity is deleted; compaction keeps it as the last word on the key.

seller_key.description: The seller whose panel offers this is about.

panel_offers_active.description: false when this seller's PANEL offers must stop being displayed — currently only because the prepaid wallet hit zero. true when they may be shown again. Crawled offers from the same seller are unaffected either way.

suspension_reason.description: Why, for the seller-facing panel and for ops — e.g. "zero_balance". null whenever panel_offers_active is true.
